productArea.name: Repository code
productArea.scope: Browse files, branches, tags, history, and commit comparisons, search code with text or regular expressions, and create, edit, upload, or patch files, commit changes, download archives, or synchronize forks. Pull request reviews, releases, repository policies, and Actions are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Code in the seeded repository and use its file tree, branch selector, file finder, history, and editing controls.
Choose Branches to inspect branch search and branch actions.
Open commit history and select a commit to inspect its diff.
Use repository code search and its Text or Regexp mode.
Use Compare commits for a read-only comparison of the two seeded branches and the switch-base/head control.
Choose Explore then Code for global code search when indexing is available.
Choose Code on the user profile to search that owner's repositories. Organization profiles offer the same search.
